headline: MBBS-Trained Physician | Medical Education, Clinical Evidence and Cross-Functional Partnership
summary: MBBS-trained physician with emergency, ICU and occupational health experience and four years in health technology. I reviewed clinical literature for evidence-based content, presented to clinician audiences, trained 200+ providers and nurses and sat on a patient safety committee. I have not worked in pharma or medical affairs and am not licensed in Canada; I am looking to move my clinical and communication skills into this field.
greenway_bullets: Reviewed clinical literature on the Clinical Content Team to keep EHR clinical content evidence-based and aligned with guidelines.
Presented clinical and product concepts to provider audiences at the Greenway Engage conference and directly to client clinical leadership.
Designed and delivered training for 200+ clinicians and staff, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants.
Patient Safety Committee member: triaged patient safety issues and defects from detection through stage-gate release.
Main clinical contact for close to 200 client practices, translating clinician needs into product decisions.
skills: clinician training, presentations, literature review, evidence synthesis
product, engineering and leadership partnership, patient safety review
emergency medicine, critical care, occupational health
why_fit: Clinical content kept aligned with guidelines.
